newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine bonds higher with market well bid.
newsitem.headline: Argentine bonds higher with market well bid.

text.p: Argentine bonds were higher late morning Thursday, as the market gained support from U.S. Treasuries.
"The market is well bid," said a trader at a foreign bank, adding that U.S. Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan's upbeat speech earlier in the week continued to underpin a strong market tone.
Argentina's FRB Brady bond due 2005 rose 1/4 to 95 while the dollar-denominated Bocon Previsional 4 due 2002 advanced $0.40 to 119.4.
Another trader said the high volatility of the last couple of weeks looked to set to remain a mainstay of the market in coming days.
